title: Quick Light Arabian Cod Bowl
description: Sweet, light, quick Saudi Arabian inspired bowl featuring salt cod, leftover roasted chicken, and fragrant spices, served from a bamboo steamer.
instructions: Prepare a bamboo steamer with water just below the first rack.
Place the soaked salt cod on the bottom rack, cover and steam for 7 minutes.
Add the shredded chicken on top of the cod and steam an additional 5 minutes.
Transfer the cooked rice to a bowl, drizzle with olive oil, and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Scatter diced cucumber and tomato over the rice.
Squeeze lemon juice over the rice and sprinkle with sumac.
Fold the steamed cod and chicken into the rice mixture gently.
Serve immediately, garnish with a few mint leaves if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
